items.problem: The 'Defensive UI for init-heavy and device-dependent pages' section lists constructor/Loaded as the throw sites and enumerates hardware/media/asset/DI triggers, but omits OnNavigatedTo and the class of view-bound WinRT APIs (DisplayInformation, ApplicationView, UIViewSettings, etc.) that compile but throw at runtime in desktop. The actual NRE and the latent AutoRotationPreferences trap both live in OnNavigatedTo.
items.evidence: SKILL.md lines 200-224 mention only 'constructor or Loaded handler' and triggers hardware/media/assets/DI; the real throw sites here are Scenario1.OnNavigatedTo (App.MainWindow NRE at line 32; DisplayInformation.AutoRotationPreferences at line 55).
items.covered_at: SKILL.md 'Defensive UI for init-heavy and device-dependent pages' (~lines 200-224)
items.proposed_improvement: Add OnNavigatedTo alongside constructor/Loaded as a throw site, and add a trigger bullet for view-bound WinRT APIs that compile but throw in desktop (DisplayInformation, ApplicationView, UIViewSettings) so init-guarding covers them too.
items.generalizes: SDK samples routinely do first-run work in OnNavigatedTo and touch view-bound WinRT APIs; widening the defensive-init guidance to those sites/APIs helps many scenarios avoid blank pages.
